name: Mindbreaker
detailed_description:
Mindbreaker is a narrative-driven VR horror game with advanced experimental physics and mechanics focused on realism. Dynamically and freely navigate around the environments, engage in thrilling fights, and realistically interact with the game world with physics heavy interactions.

EXPERIENCE A TERRIFYING SINGLEPLAYER CAMPAIGN

Experience a terrifying yet gripping narrative as you play as a test subject for a brutal experiment designed to push the human mind to its limits. How much will it take for your mind to break? It's time to find out.

FIGHT OR FLIGHT

Choose to either avoid all confrontation and stealth past your enemies, or attempt to neutralize them in cold-blood. The game reacts to the choices you make, and your actions throughout the game will ultimately shape how the story plays out. The choice is yours, do whatever you deem necessary to survive.

IMPROVISE OR DIE

Different weapons are scattered all around the environment, and you must be able to improvise and make the best use of what's been given to you. Resources and ammo are scarce, so you must be strategic if you want to survive.

ADVANCED VR SYSTEM AND PHYSICS

The game features a custom full-body IK system, that allows for maximum immersion and sense of presence in the game world. And the advanced physics also open the door for thrilling sequences and realistic interactions with the environment.

ATTENTION: This game demonstrates advanced VR mechanics and concepts. The game also makes use of smooth locomotion which may also cause motion sickness for some VR newcomers. Players are recommended to have previous VR experience and understanding of common VR gameplay principles before proceeding.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 7600 3.5ghz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / 1660TI (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: Standing or Sitting. SteamVR or Oculus PCVR. Quest 1/2/3/pro via AirLink, Cable, SteamLink or Virtual Desktop, Valve Index, HTC Vive, Vive Pro 1/2, Oculus Rift, Rift S, Samsung Odyssey (other WMRs should work too), Vive Cosmos, Pimax.
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations. Better on SSD. Requires VR Headset to play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: Intel i7 9700k or greater, 3.6 ghz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 or above / equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: Standing or Sitting. SteamVR or Oculus PCVR. Quest 1/2/3/pro via AirLink, Cable, SteamLink or Virtual Desktop, Valve Index, HTC Vive, Vive Pro 1/2, Oculus Rift, Rift S, Samsung Odyssey (other WMRs should work too), Vive Cosmos, Pimax.
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations. Better on SSD. Requires VR Headset to play.
